newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's Inc applies for NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's Inc applies for NYSE listing.

text.p: Proffitt's Inc said on Thursday it applied for listing of its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange.

Its shares are expected to begin trading on the NYSE in early July under the symbol "PFT." Proffitt's has traded on the Nasdaq National Market under the symbol "PRFT" since June 1987 when it completed its initial public offering. Since then, market capitalization has grown to over one billion dollars from $8 million previously.
Proffitt's operates 175 stores in twenty-four states under various store names. Its annualized revenues are in excess of $2.3 billion.
